definitions.explanation: A long, thin rod used for knitting yarn into fabric. Typically sold in pairs or sets and available in various thicknesses.

examples.japanese: ⟦{太|ふと}い→太い：02955_futoi⟧{編|あ}み{棒|ぼう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ほう⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{初心者|しょしんしゃ}→初心者：10149_shoshinsha⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{使|つか}いやすい→使いやすい：30380_tsukaiyasui⟧。
examples.english: Thicker knitting needles are easier for beginners to use.

examples.japanese: ⟦{祖母|そぼ}→祖母：00813_sobo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{編|あ}み{棒|ぼう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{手|て}→手：00569_te⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{取|と}る→取る：00565_toru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、⟦あっという{間|ま}に→あっという間に：25467_attoiumani⟧⟦マフラー→マフラー：04533_mafuraa⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{編|あ}み{上|あ}げた。
examples.english: When my grandmother picked up her knitting needles, she finished a scarf in no time.

notes:
USAGE:
{編|あ}み{棒|ぼう} refers to the straight needles used for knitting. For crochet hooks, the term is かぎ{針|ばり}.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {編|あ}み{棒|ぼう}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{編|あ}む→編む：00002_amu⟧ (to knit with needles)
- ⟦{竹|たけ}→竹：02220_take⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{編|あ}み{棒|ぼう} (bamboo knitting needles)
- {編|あ}み{棒|ぼう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{太|ふと}さ (knitting needle thickness)

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{毛糸|けいと}→毛糸：00212_keito⟧: yarn, knitting wool
- ⟦{編|あ}み{物|もの}→編み物：06364_amimono⟧: knitting, knitted goods
- かぎ{針|ばり}: crochet hook
